summary_of_bug: FastMath.cosh(double) and FastMath.sinh(double) overflow to Infinity for large-magnitude inputs near the upper finite range where Math.cosh/sinh still return finite doubles. The failing tests show this for both positive and negative x between about ±log(Double.MAX_VALUE) and ±2*log(sqrt(2)*sqrt(Double.MAX_VALUE)), with errors exceeding the allowed ~3 ulps versus Math. The bug report attributes this to computing these functions as exp(|x|)/2 for large |x|, which overflows prematurely; the implementation needs a split form based on exp(|x|/2) so the final result remains finite when possible.
